prompt: Write the church bulletin item quietly announcing that Carol is no longer in charge of the bake sale. You may not say anything negative about Carol, and every reader must nonetheless understand exactly what Carol did.
response:
**BAKE SALE UPDATE**

We are pleased to announce that the Spring Bake Sale will proceed as scheduled on Saturday, May 18th, in the Fellowship Hall.

The congregation extends its heartfelt thanks to Carol for her years of dedicated service organizing this beloved event. We are grateful for all the time and energy she has devoted to our community.

Going forward, the Bake Sale will be coordinated by the Fellowship Committee as a whole. All proceeds will continue to be counted by two volunteers together, recorded in the ledger, and deposited the same afternoon by the Treasurer. A full accounting will be posted on the bulletin board following each event.

We look forward to seeing everyone there, and we thank you for your continued generosity in support of the Building Fund—every dollar of which reaches its intended purpose.
